description.value: A lakeside lodge and campground in the Pine Pass on paved Highway 97, with an on-site café serving homemade meals, kayaking, fishing, and adjacent Powder King ski resort; a commercial, year-round destination that draws both summer and winter visitors.

address.value: Mile 122 John Hart Hwy, Mackenzie, BC V0J 2C0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and provides contact details, on-site food (Café 97), and a 'Book Now' button confirming reservations are accepted. OSM tags confirm tents=yes, caravans=yes, internet_access=wlan, and picnic_table=yes; the website corroborates the WiFi SSID 'AZU' indirectly and the on-site café explicitly. No specific cycling amenities (pump, tools, hiker-biker sites) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM charge tag reads '50 USD' — this is a Canadian business; the currency is almost certainly CAD, not USD. OSM tag should be corrected.
OSM has no phone number; phone 1 250 750 0044 sourced from website contact page only.
OSM address is just 'John Hart Highway' with no mile marker or postal code; website provides 'Mile 122 John Hart Hwy, Mackenzie, BC V0J 2C0'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active campground with on-site food service at a remote but strategically important location on the John Hart Highway — a clear benefit to touring cyclists travelling this corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Property is affiliated with Powder King Mountain Resort; hostel accommodation is also available on-site. Public bus service (BC Bus) stops here per the 'Getting Here' page, suggesting it is a recognized waypoint on this remote highway.

wow_evidence: on-site café serving homemade meals...strategically important location on the John Hart Highway
